criteria.statement: The generic Nostr subscriber audits the canonical control-plane request namespace handled by the reactor.
Control-plane request audit filters are scoped by default, direct-runtime, and adoption operator author groups without widening unrelated filters.
Existing validation-before-persistence and deterministic EOSE/CLOSED subscriber behavior remain unchanged.
Reactor outbound event auditing receives the Nostr event repository whether packages are enabled or disabled.
Bahia Nostr kind constants are single-sourced from internal/kinds; backend aliases and generated frontend constants fail tests on drift.
The PSTF route transport matrix records every audited route/control surface using the shared taxonomy and repository-backed evidence.
tests: route-transport-matrix.test.js: uses only the shared orchestration taxonomy and covers every audited route/control surface

criteria.statement: Signer-first Nostr route files cannot import REST/API clients for command ingress unless the matrix classifies that route file's HTTP use as rest_to_nostr_bridge, rest_compatibility, or http_native.
tests: route-transport-matrix.test.js: keeps REST/API route imports explicit and limited to non-signer-first surfaces
route-transport-matrix.test.js: fails if a pure signer-first route starts importing REST clients for command ingress
